summary: Interlude (Mars Climate Orbiter): contract-level testing would catch units mismatch; Module 06 'units' are UUID/ISO-8601/open|booked/error envelope — CP1 enum diff is the early-warning pattern.
evidence: Q1: Contract tests / consumer-driven contract tests / golden fixtures asserting units+types on the wire — not more unit tests inside Lockheed or JPL. SIS must be executable.

Q2: Our units = UUID strings (not ints), ISO-8601 Z datetimes, slot_status open|booked (not available), error {code,message}. Divergence mode = Module 06 available vs open. Detection = CP1 field-by-field contract diff + CI ALLOWED enum assert before merge.
